duration: Rehearse before presenting; no completion guarantee
summary: Phases 4-6. Start only after real laptop acceptance. Restore is explicit; daily checks and F5 never hide package, helper or image acquisition.

steps.title: Start with an accepted environment
steps.where: Verify results › Intended VS Code profile
do: Confirm pinned runtimes, enabled required extensions, approved source/profile and separately approved GitHub/Copilot access.
Keep unavailable commands NOT RUN; do not install to make a daily check pass.
steps.see: Observed readiness, not the guide's progress ticks or old CI.

steps.title: Explicitly Restore project dependencies
steps.where: Terminal › Run Task › Restore project dependencies
do: Choose Dependencies and the intended sample, or All for modern Python/Java/Go/PowerShell.
Review network/package acquisition and confirm it yourself; legacy remains opt-in.
steps.see: Restored pinned environments/modules, with missing runtime/provider prerequisites reported.

steps.title: Run daily no-restore checks
steps.where: Terminal › Run Task › Test all samples / Lint all samples / Coverage all samples
do: Use existing runtimes and already restored dependencies only.
Read actual failures/skips and report outputs; offline mode alone is not enough to prevent cached restore.
steps.see: Observed pass/fail/NOT RUN and actual reports, not a copied command list.

steps.title: Choose a separate human local launch
steps.where: Terminal › Run Task › Run EMI API (local) / Run IFSC service (local) / Run FX rates (local)
do: Use the already prepared intended sample; tasks select ports 8080/8081/8082.
Keep the launch terminal open and use another terminal for requests.
steps.warn: Agents do not start apps, containers or servers.
steps.see: The task's actual endpoint or a truthful NOT RUN; startup is not assumed.

steps.title: Check health and a synthetic request
do: Only after human-confirmed startup, run health and the documented synthetic request.
Compare response strings/INR grouping; expected examples are not historical laptop observations.
steps.see: Health status ok and EMI 21695.58 for the documented example, only if actually observed.

steps.title: Keep F5 and containers acquisition-free
steps.where: Run and Debug › FastAPI EMI / Spring Boot IFSC / Go FX
do: F5 requires existing locked debugpy, correct JDK/restored project or approved Delve.
Container builds belong only to confirmed Restore ContainerImages; Run inspects an existing image and uses --pull=never.
steps.see: No hidden dependency/tool/image download; missing prerequisites are NOT RUN.

steps.title: Review, publish only authorized work, inspect exact-SHA CI
steps.where: Source Control › GitHub Pull Requests view
do: Separate sign-in, commit/publish and PR decisions; stage only intended files and preserve the template.
Observe every modern-service job/artifact on the actual SHA. Push/PR never deploys.
steps.see: A small reviewed change and genuine checks; optional AKS is a separate human approval path.
